about: BANZAI 1.3.2: which of Darren's original class-identity JPEGs is which class. Made by looking at every image (dominant colours against Darren's approved class colour system, and the emblem); the Gemini file names say nothing about the class. tools/icons.js checks it: every file in the folder mapped or excluded, 13 sources, 13 unique classes, the SHA-256 of each source unchanged.
